claim_text: For 0<delta<1/2, Theorem 2 replaces the full-coupling score assumption H3 by the conditional-coupling score assumption H4 and retains an O(d^3) KL bound under early stopping.

witness.H3_failure: The joint is supported on R^d x {0}, a zero-Lebesgue-measure subset of R^(2d).
witness.H4_reason: pi_{0|1}=N(0,I_d), whose positive C-infinity density has an L8 score.

acceptance_criteria: The witness satisfies H1, H2, and H4 while demonstrably violating H3.
For every tested positive delta, the exact early-stopped KL is finite and decreases as h decreases.
An independent symbolic checker proves the explicit Theorem 2 factor is O(d^3).
A 50-digit recurrence independently matches the implementation.
